message: Hi Alex, it's Dev at Polar HVAC, ok. Can you guarantee this gets me 30 more customers a month? I need a promise.
reply: Hi Dev, honest answer: no, I can't promise a number of customers — anyone who does is guessing. What I can do is fix the issues actually hurting your site (speed, broken forms, mobile, etc.) for $900 one-time. That removes real obstacles between visitors and calls, but results depend on your market too. Happy to send the audit if useful.
